verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only the QuickBooks Workforce API, which lets third-party apps connect to QuickBooks companies to view employees and manage deductions, payslips, pensions and webhooks. That is an integration API for existing QuickBooks payroll customers, not a white-label embedded payroll offering a developer can ship under its own brand. The developer docs also point to Intuit branding assets, and nothing documents a partner or embedded program, so the adjacent integration API earns no credit for this story.
